description: Service-error mapping: an unmapped exception thrown by a method becomes a generic error-not-handled response, while exceptions explicitly mapped to a code are reported with that code; an explicit message and data override the defaults, and when no message override is given the thrown exception's own message is surfaced. Host-language class names are never exposed.

cases.description: mapped exception reports the configured code
explicit message and data override the defaults
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-5678
error_category=custom
error_message=The message
error_data=The data

cases.description: thrown exception message surfaces when not overridden
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=1234
error_category=custom
error_message=exception message
error_data_message=exception message
